policies.sentence: Students may use AI to interpret or explain error messages, but not to provide a fix.
Students may use AI for debugging help, hints, and code explanations.
Students must diagnose the problem themselves first, and not ask AI to fix it in their place.
Students must not use AI to debug their own code and should debug their lab code themselves.
Only course staff may provide solution-specific debugging assistance.
Students may use generative AI to understand why tests failed after the deadline.
